description: Defines the ResetPasswordRequest entity class for ORM, representing password reset requests with properties like email, request date, reset code, and expiration status.

classes.name: ResetPasswordRequest
classes.description: Entity class mapping to the 'ohrm_reset_password' table, encapsulating password reset request data.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the reset password request.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the reset password request.

methods.name: getResetEmail
methods.description: Returns the email associated with the reset request.

methods.name: setResetEmail
methods.description: Sets the email associated with the reset request.

methods.name: getResetRequestDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the reset request was made.

methods.name: setResetRequestDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the reset request was made.

methods.name: getResetCode
methods.description: Returns the reset code for password reset.

methods.name: setResetCode
methods.description: Sets the reset code for password reset.

methods.name: getExpired
methods.description: Returns whether the reset request has expired.

methods.name: setExpired
methods.description: Sets the expiration status of the reset request.
